lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Horizontal rows of discrete high-luminance circular pixel clusters extending from the posterior branchial region across the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity crossing the horizontal spot lineages, forming a low-contrast grid-like arrangement of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features across the mid-to-upper flank characterized by a high-intensity superior edge and a low-intensity inferior shadow.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density clustering of small-diameter high-luminance blobs on the surface of the visible pectoral fin.
